intro: Reading an advert and asking the owner the questions that matter, with ser, estar and tener.
p.alquiler.consejo: It comes from «alquilar». You say «pagar el alquiler» and «el alquiler del piso».
p.alquilar.consejo: On a sign, «se alquila» means the flat is available to live in, paying every month.
p.amueblado.consejo: It changes with the noun: «piso amueblado», «casa amueblada». The opposite is «vacío».
p.exterior.consejo: An exterior flat has its windows onto the street, not onto an inner courtyard.
p.luminoso.consejo: It comes from «luz»: lots of light comes in. It changes: «luminoso», «luminosa».
p.calefacción.consejo: It ends in -ción: accent on the ó. It is used in winter; in summer there is air conditioning.
p.ascensor.consejo: The stress falls at the end: as-then-SOR. You say «subir en ascensor».
p.gastos.consejo: It is almost always plural. «Gastos incluidos» or «gastos no incluidos» says whether they are already in the price.
p.fianza.consejo: It is paid at the start and is usually returned at the end if all is well. The z sounds «th».
p.contrato.consejo: You say «firmar el contrato». Read it carefully before signing.
p.dueño.consejo: It changes: «dueño», «dueña». The ñ sounds ny: DWE-nyo.
p.al mes.consejo: It says how often something is paid: «750 euros al mes». «Por mes» is also heard.
p.piso.consejo: In Spain «piso» is a flat; it is also each storey: «el tercer piso».
p.libre.consejo: If the flat is libre, nobody lives in it and it can be rented.
b1.titulo: Ser, estar and tener to describe a flat
b1.texto:
A typical advert: **Se alquila** piso luminoso de dos habitaciones, **amueblado**, **exterior** y con **ascensor**. 750 € **al mes**; **gastos no incluidos**. Fianza: un mes.

Three verbs help describe it:

- **Es** luminoso, grande, tranquilo. (what it is like)
- **Está** amueblado, cerca del metro. (state or place)
- **Tiene** dos habitaciones, calefacción, ascensor. (what it has)

Useful questions: **¿Cuántas habitaciones tiene?** **¿Están incluidos los gastos?** **¿De cuánto es la fianza?** **¿Puedo ver el piso?**

In Spain, **un piso** is a flat, but also a floor of a building: vivo en el tercer piso.
b2.f0.texto: I am calling about the flat in the advert.
b2.f2.texto: It has two bedrooms and is very bright.
b2.f3.texto: Is it furnished and does it have a lift?
b2.f4.texto: It is furnished and has heating.
b2.f6.texto: It is seven hundred and fifty euros a month.
b4.texto:
To talk about a house, each verb has its job:

- **ser** + adjective: what it is like. El piso **es** luminoso y grande.
- **estar** + adjective or place: state and location. El piso **está** amueblado; **está** cerca del metro.
- **tener** + noun: what is inside. El edificio **tiene** ascensor.

Adjectives agree: **piso amueblado**, **casa amueblada**, **habitaciones luminosas**.

Price numbers go with **euros al mes**: setecientos cincuenta euros **al mes**.
b4.e0.texto: The flat is bright and quiet.
b4.e2.texto: The building has a lift and heating.
b5.f0.texto: The staircase smells of dust and old wood.
b5.f1.texto: The owner opens the door with a heavy key.
b5.f2.texto: A soft light comes in through the windows of the living room.
b5.f3.texto: Lucía walks slowly through the empty rooms.
b5.f4.texto: Her steps sound on the light wooden floor.
b5.f5.texto: From the kitchen window you can see a green courtyard.
b5.f6.texto: A grey cat sleeps on a sunny wall.
b5.f7.texto: The heating creaks with a friendly sound.
b5.f8.texto: Lucía imagines her table next to the big window.
b5.f9.texto: The owner smiles and hands her the contract and a blue pen.
b6.o0.refuerzo: Well done! With a state, like «amueblado», you use «estar».
b6.o1.refuerzo: «Es amueblado» is not said: a state goes with «estar».
b6.pregunta: Choose the verb for the flat's state.
b7.o0.refuerzo: Yes! You do not pay those charges separately.
b7.o2.refuerzo: There are charges; they are just already paid for.
b8.frase: Cuánto es el alquiler al mes
b8.traduccion: How much is the rent per month
b9.o0.refuerzo: That's it: «al mes» says how often it is paid.
b9.o1.refuerzo: «En mes» is not said for a monthly price.
b9.o2.refuerzo: «De mes» does not work here; use «al mes».
b10.pregunta: Write in Spanish: «Does it have a lift?»
b11.o0.refuerzo: It has nothing to do with the lift.
b11.o1.refuerzo: Exactly! It is a guarantee for the owner.
b11.o2.refuerzo: The owner has his own name; the fianza is money.
b11.pregunta: The advert says «fianza: un mes». What is it?
b12.o0.refuerzo: Well done: with the name of a thing you use «tener».
b12.o1.refuerzo: «Es calefacción» would say the building is the heating.
b12.o2.refuerzo: «Está calefacción» is not said: «tiene» is missing.
b12.pregunta: Choose the verb for what the building has.
p.anuncio.consejo: The c before i sounds like «th».
p.incluidos.consejo: From «incluir». The ui is two syllables here because of the accent.
p.pesada.consejo: Feminine form of «pesado». The stress is on SA.
p.pasea.consejo: From «pasear», to stroll. The two vowels are separate syllables.
